target.statement: Geom 50 achieves Point Jaccard distance ~0.064 at p-q=0.10 on NYC zip codes (vs Centroid/Random Point needing p-q~0.35-0.4)
target.dataset: NYC ZIP code polygons (263 polygons, 248 ZIPs)

compute.basis: Paper reports ~0.3 s per pyScan discovery on 3,711 regions; NYC has 263 regions x 50 points, so 20 trials x ~11 p-values is minutes of scan time, dominated by install and shapefile download.

blockers: NYC ZIP shapefile source not explicitly cited in text (likely NYC open data / Census TIGER, needs locating)
exact planted rectangle coordinates and seeds not given, so exact 0.064 value may not match; trend reproducible

title: Sampling for Region-Aggregated Spatial Scan Statistics
